learning_objective: 🎯 We will visit a colorful market in our minds, learn how beautiful glass bangles are made, and appreciate the hard work of the craftsmen!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: The story takes us to a busy and bright market filled with shops selling glass bangles. They look like colorful rainbows kept on the shelves.
We learn that making these bangles is very hard work. Craftsmen sit near hot fires to melt the glass and carefully shape them into perfect circles.
When you wear glass bangles, they hit each other and make a sweet, musical tinkling sound that makes everyone smile.

fun_activity.title: 🎨 Paper Bangle Craft
fun_activity.instructions: Cut a strip of thick paper, color it beautifully with your crayons, and tape the ends together to make your very own paper bangle!

quick_recap: ⭐ Glass bangles come in many beautiful, shiny colors.
⭐ Craftsmen work very hard near hot fires to shape the melted glass.
⭐ Bangles make a lovely, musical sound when they clink together on your wrist.
